title: A német megszállás és a holokauszt (German Occupation & Rescuers (1944))
grammar: Causal Triggers, Tragedy Descriptors & Historical Memorial Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can understand and discuss German Occupation & Rescuers (1944) in Hungary's WWII history.
I can say that something happened in spite of a danger, with annak ellenére, hogy.
I can say what happened in Hungary after 19 March 1944.
I can use six words about the occupation and the rescuers, such as deportálás and embermentők.
